title: Completing the classification of torsion subgroups for rational elliptic curves over sextic fields
summary: We complete the classification of torsion subgroups $E(K)_{\text{tors}}$ that can occur for an elliptic curve $E/\mathbb{Q}$ over a sextic number field $K$. Previous work determined the complete set of these groups, leaving the existence of only one group in question: $C_3 \oplus C_{18}$. We prove that this group does not occur. Our proof relies on the theory of Galois representations attached to elliptic curves.
